messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Gedo Works produces Sepa Z82

response: According to the filing, Gedo Works produces Sepa Z82 at its main plant. The records say the product has been in regular output since early this year.
